entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this useless VeloBand sensor. I've had it with this thing and I want my money back. Now.
I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with the product. I can certainly look into that return for you. Could I get your name and order number to start?
The name is Sam Jones. Order number is VF8675309. And don't 'look into it,' just process the refund. This is the worst customer service I've ever experienced.

Okay, Mr. Jones, I'm pulling up your order now. I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor delivered about a month ago. So I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

The issue is that it's a piece of junk and I don't want it! I'm not answering a survey, I'm demanding a refund. Are you going to do it or do I need to speak to your manager? I'm already drafting my one-star review and I'll post it everywhere.
I understand your frustration, sir, and there's no need to speak to a manager. I can absolutely handle this for you. I just need a moment to check the return eligibility based on the delivery date.
Unbelievable. Just find a reason to tell me it's too late, right? I swear, if you try to deny this...
Not at all. Actually, it's good news. I see here it was delivered 39 days ago, which places you well within our 90-day return policy.

I've gone ahead and approved the return for a full refund. I just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Once our warehouse receives the item, you'll see the refund credited back to your original payment method in 3 to 5 business days.
Oh. So it's approved? Just like that?
Yes, sir. You were well within the timeframe. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No. I guess not. That was... fine. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
